limitations: The 28 cases are a regression smoke set, not a statistical benchmark.
Cases are white-box and derived from the same repository they evaluate.
Synthetic inputs do not represent real-user or incident distributions.
The dataset is Korean-first; three phishing cases declare English locale and multilingual quality is not comprehensively measured.
No independent finance, legal, security, privacy, accessibility, or fairness expert review is recorded.
GPT-5.6 Sol provenance is a self-described Codex session record without a portable run ID or cryptographic signature.
Stored API snapshots are not live captures and do not prove current availability or freshness.
Submission evidence checks structural reference counts and claims, not every referenced file's existence or content quality.
The core dataset hash does not include the separate API snapshot or evidence manifest bytes.
No generative-AI answer quality, hallucination, or model fairness is scored.
Public route parsing, rate limiting, browser integration, and network behavior require separate tests.
Subjective hackathon criteria and measured KPI impact are outside the automatic score.

procedure: Check out the exact repository commit.
Verify all three JSON files use Git text=set and eol=lf.
Compare all three raw SHA-256 values with this provenance manifest.
Install dependencies from the committed lockfile.
Run focused and full test suites and retain logs.
Create a fresh build so stale dist artifacts cannot be deployed.
Retain exported dataset ID, core hash, runner version, case digests, assertions, timestamps, auxiliary hashes, and Git commit.
Perform separate live deployment diagnostics and independent human domain review before external claims.

maintenancePolicy.coreFixtureByteChange: Recompute and update the core SHA-256 everywhere it is pinned.
maintenancePolicy.auxiliaryArtifactChange: Recompute its SHA-256 and update this provenance document; do not imply the unchanged core hash binds it.
maintenancePolicy.runnerSemanticChange: Increment runnerVersion and reject incompatible stored sessions.
maintenancePolicy.incompatibleSchemaChange: Publish a new dataset file and datasetId.
maintenancePolicy.provenanceOnlyChange: Do not change executable fixture hashes or runner version; track documentation in Git.
maintenancePolicy.legacyPolicy: Preserve v1 provenance unchanged as a historical record.
